title: Malicious code in campus_baby_by_lex_martin_htsnt (npm)
description: The npm package 'campus_baby_by_lex_martin_htsnt' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee full remediation, as the attacker may have established persistent control over the system.
